decisions.reason: The MMAK modular plant concept is a visible strategic flagship with a publicly quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros per year, so the firm's investment and public commitment strongly favor persisting.
The slow-speed shredder belongs to the firm's core product line and has its own dedicated page, reflecting substantial investment and visible commitment, so the firm will keep it.

This second modular plant concept is less prominently shown and could be merged or renamed, but it fits the announced modular strategy, and early weak visibility can be attributed to the recent launch.
The mobile trommel screen is a core part of the firm's mobile processing range and a component of its modular plant concept, so it is central to the announced direction and likely kept.
